ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota's handling of SNAP data
ideas.description: The Justice Department's lawsuit against Minnesota over refusal to turn over SNAP data raises questions about the state's administration of the program and potential vulnerabilities.
questions: What are the implications of Minnesota's refusal to turn over SNAP data?
How does this relate to other investigations into corruption and mismanagement of government programs?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential corruption and mismanagement in Minnesota's administration of SNAP, and shed light on the state's response to federal scrutiny.

ideas.title: Campaign finance violations by US Representatives
ideas.description: Recent investigations into campaign finance violations by US Representatives, including Ruben Gallego, raise concerns about the integrity of political fundraising.
questions: What are the implications of campaign finance violations by US Representatives?
How do these investigations relate to broader concerns about corruption and accountability in politics?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential corruption and abuse of power in political fundraising, and shed light on the need for greater transparency and accountability.
